content.text:
Original lot reports and commercial terms have separate sign-in requirements. A source report is not a certification or a guarantee that a lot meets your targets. Supplier-reported values and buyer evaluations are distinct from authenticated laboratory evidence.

Private sourcing notes stay in the buyer account. Explicitly shared summaries reach suppliers in the matching category. Conversations are restricted to their participants. Soft holds do not form a purchase contract; contract and payment happen off-platform.

Live TECRID authentication and laboratory ordering require an authorized integration. Kasandrinos’s authorized team can receive sourcing inquiries.
